description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelMenuAction' with nested class 'SetField', used for modeling menu actions and setting fields within a widget framework in OFBiz. It includes methods for reading sub-actions and executing set actions, handling context, session, and application scope variables.

classes.name: ModelMenuAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a menu action in the widget framework, providing static methods for reading sub-actions.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: Nested static class extending AbstractModelAction, modeling the <set> element for setting variables in different scopes with support for default values and type conversion.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-actions from an XML element, returning a list of ModelAction instances, including 'SetField' and other actions.

methods.name: SetField (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a SetField instance with configuration from an XML element, setting up field accessors and parameters.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the set action, retrieving and setting variables in session, application, or local context based on configuration.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for the ModelAction, following the visitor pattern.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleMapAccessor for the target field.

methods.name: getFromField
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleMapAccessor for the source field.

methods.name: getValueExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the value expression.

methods.name: getDefaultExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the default value.

methods.name: getGlobalExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the global expression.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the variable to set.

methods.name: getToScope
methods.description: Returns the scope where the variable should be set (user, application, or local).

methods.name: getFromScope
methods.description: Returns the scope from which to retrieve the value.
